2459-5006-5147-8170.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
2459-5006-5147-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

4279-6255-6273--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6255-6273--216.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You have max speed.
4279-6255-6273--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1432-2645-3430-3478.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-2645-3430-3478.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

116-512-4137.easyPrerequisites: Blossom-Clad Werewolf and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-4137.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Blossom-Clad Werewolf, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

81-512-4091.easyPrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 2 or greater.
81-512-4091.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Kami of Whispered Hopes, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
81-512-4091.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-6255-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6255-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Zahur triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

978-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with persist
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

728-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

911-3899-6972--112.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
911-3899-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1172-7433.description:
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate by paying {B}{B} and all remaining available mana, causing each opponent to lose a significant amount of life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
1172-7433.notes: The more life you have, the more life your opponents will lose. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Exsanguinate.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4742-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

5929-7686-7764.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5929-7686-7764.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Seton four times by tapping four Squirrels, as they'll be Druids due to Leyline of Transformation, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5929-7686-7764.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped.

560-2558-2829-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
When the Soldier enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

2842-4681-5170-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

803-2366-2438-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
803-2366-2438-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3214-6899.description:
Activate Firedrinker Satyr by paying {1}{R}, attempting to deal 1 damage to you, but dealing 1 damage to Firedrinker Satyr instead due to With Great Power....
Firedrinker Satyr triggers, attempting to deal 1 damage to you, but dealing 1 damage to Firedrinker Satyr instead due to With Great Power....
Repeat step 2 in an infinite loop, which causes the game to end in a draw.

372-2974-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Illusionist's Stratagem.
372-2974-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

4275-5470-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a Human creature token, a Shaman creature token, and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
4275-5470-6797.description:
Create a creature token that is a Human and/or Shaman, and/or has changeling.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token created in step 2.
When the creature token dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures that share a creature type with it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat from step 2.

671-1274-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-1274-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

710-772-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Danitha's power.
Repeat.

147-167-5686.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

1170-2397-2733-5478-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

331-791-1605-3693.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
331-791-1605-3693.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1879-3259-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
1879-3259-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

433-4543-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Llanowar Scout exiled with brain counters on them.
433-4543-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Llanowar Scout's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Rex using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Rex.
Repeat.

1940-2034-4191-5010.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {C}{C}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Liliana trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

626-2034-3374.notablePrerequisites: Daghatar does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
626-2034-3374.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Daghatar persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Daghatar, adding {C}{C}.
When Daghatar dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with three +1/+1 counters on it due to its ability.
Repeat.

2882-4671-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4671-4675-4694.description:
Cast Accorder's Shield by paying {0}.
Accorder's Shield enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Accorder's Shield from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

478-617-1846-4235.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Islands.
478-617-1846-4235.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}, causing all Islands to add an additional {U} when they are tapped for mana this turn.
Activate two Islands you control by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Candelabra of Tawnos' ability.
Resolve the first Candelabra of Tawnos ability, untapping the two Islands.
Activate two Islands you control by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Candelabra of Tawnos ability, untapping the two Islands.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping Voltaic Key and Candelabra of Tawnos.
Repeat from step 2.

868-2670-5149-5261.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Isochron Scepter.
868-2670-5149-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter for {1}.
Splice Desperate Ritual onto Psychic Puppetry for {1}{R}, and have Psychic Puppetry target Isochron Scepter.
Resolve the spell, untapping Isochron Scepter and adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat as necessary, using {R} to pay for the Isochron Scepter activation and {R}{R} for Desperate Ritual.
